terms.title: Terms of use
terms.offlineNotice: The official terms could not be loaded. A temporary offline copy is shown below.
terms.introduction: These temporary terms govern your use of Qaren until the official online terms are published. By using the application, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: You must read and accept these terms before using Qaren. If you do not agree with any part of them, please stop using the application.

account.title: Account responsibility
account.body: You are responsible for providing accurate information, protecting your account and verification methods, and notifying us if you suspect unauthorized access.

service.title: Purpose of the service
service.body: Qaren helps users discover and compare available services, prices and offers. Availability and comparison results may vary by location, time and provider.

providers.title: Third-party providers
providers.body: Some services are supplied by independent providers. Their availability, quality, fulfilment and additional conditions remain the responsibility of the relevant provider.

prices.title: Prices and payments
prices.body: Displayed prices may change before final confirmation. You must review the final price, fees, payment method and cancellation terms before completing a request.

location.title: Location and permissions
location.body: Location, notifications, camera or biometric permissions are used only when needed for an enabled feature and can be managed through your device settings.

prohibited.title: Prohibited use
prohibited.body: You may not misuse the application, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with its operation, submit unlawful content, impersonate others or use the service for fraud.

availability.title: Availability and liability
availability.body: We work to keep Qaren accurate and available, but uninterrupted operation or error-free third-party information cannot be guaranteed. Nothing in these terms excludes rights that cannot legally be excluded.

termination.title: Suspension and termination
termination.body: Access may be limited or suspended when required for security, maintenance, legal compliance or a material breach of these terms.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: These temporary terms may be updated when the service changes or the official online terms are published. The latest applicable version will be made available through Qaren.

contact.title: Contact and complaints
contact.body: For questions, complaints or privacy requests, use Qaren's official support channels. Privacy-related requests are handled according to the published privacy policy.
